claims.explanation: SB-366791 is a selective TRPV1 antagonist, and its antiproliferative selectivity is best explained by TRPV1 expression in the cancer cells rather than by any single driver mutation. Lines with neuroendocrine/neural-crest or squamous/adenocarcinoma features that retain TRPV1 channel expression are sensitized, while lines with low TRPV1 expression or strong survival signaling through EGFR/RAS/BRAF-MAPK are protected. The recurrent TP53 mutation in killed lines is likely a passenger reflecting the screened lineages rather than the causal selective feature.

NRAS-mutant lines (IPC298, KU1919) are among least affected
KRAS-mutant colorectal/pancreatic lines (CL11, T3M4) are among least affected
PTEN-mutant lines (786O, KALS1, IGR37) are among least affected
NF1-mutant lines (KALS1, S117, BICR6) are among least affected
TP53 mutation is highly recurrent in killed lines but also common in protected lines, so weak
PIK3CA mutation appears in several killed gastric/colorectal lines
ARID1A mutation appears in several killed lines (SNUC5, HEC265, LOXIMVI)
KMT2D mutation appears in several killed lines (SNUC5, KE39, KYSE270)
SMARCA4 mutation appears in killed lines OV7 and KYSE270
